### 1 — Scene
A breakfast plate of scrambled eggs, roasted potatoes, fresh fruit, and leafy salad.

### 2 — Vessel
A square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².** The plate edges are partly cropped, so scale is approximate.

### 3 — Items
Scrambled eggs, roasted skin-on potatoes, cantaloupe, strawberries, blueberries, and mixed leafy greens. The greens appear lightly glossy; I estimate a small amount of dressing oil.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Bulk density is the only reduction applied to the food volumes.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Scrambled eggs | 24% | 127 cm² × 1.4 cm = 178 ml | 0.95 | 169 g | 180 | 304 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 16% | 85 cm² × 2.0 cm = 170 ml | 0.70 | 119 g | 150 | 179 kcal |
| Cantaloupe | 13% | 69 cm² × 1.7 cm = 117 ml | 0.60 | 70 g | 34 | 24 kcal |
| Strawberries | 6% | 32 cm² × 1.4 cm = 45 ml | 0.65 | 29 g | 32 | 9 kcal |
| Blueberries | 2% | 11 cm² × 1.0 cm = 11 ml | 0.65 | 7 g | 57 | 4 kcal |
| Mixed leafy greens | 19% | 101 cm² × 2.2 cm = 222 ml | 0.15 | 33 g | 20 | 7 kcal |
| Dressing oil, estimated | Coating* | Approximately 4.4 ml | 0.91 | 4 g | 884 | 35 kcal |

Food coverage totals **80%** of the plate.  
*Oil coats the greens and does not occupy additional plate area. Egg and potato energy densities already include their estimated cooking fat.*

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **431 g and 562 kcal** is plausible for the visible meal: substantial eggs and potatoes, a modest fruit portion, and a bulky but lightweight salad. The largest uncertainties are plate scale and added fat.
